headline: Approved personnel recommendations 3-0; head teacher job descriptions and evaluations discussed, with more to come.
summary: The committee discussed HR job openings, including teacher, school psychologist, and food service positions. It also discussed certification acronyms and head teacher job descriptions and evaluations. Members approved the personnel recommendations by a 3-0 vote.

decision_evidence.quote: Ms. Lewis moved, seconded by Ms. Giglio, to approve the Personnel Recommendations dated 7-20-26. Motion passes 3-0.

HUMAN RESOURCES COMMITTEE MEETING 
MONDAY, JULY 20, 2026 
NHS NORTH BOARD ROOM 
 
A meeting of the Human Resources Committee was held at NHS North on Monday, July 20, 2026.  Ms. Giglio 
called the meeting to order at 5:40 pm. 
 
Present:  Ms. Giglio, Ms. Raymond, Ms. Lewis, and Ms. Lopez 
 
Also Present: Channel 99 Videographer, Dr. Andrade, Mr. Bowse 
 
HR Update 
• Mr. Bowse provides an HR update on job openings, including teacher positions, school psychologists, 
speech language pathologists, behavior techs, food service openings, and more.   
• Ms. Giglio inquires about the two school psychologists, confirming they are district employees. 
• Dr. Andrade asks about the number of special educators among the 23 teachers, and Mr. Bowse clarifies 
that 14.5 are intensive needs. 
• Ms. Lewis asks about the time to fill positions, and Mr. Bowse mentions the applicant tracking system 
can provide that data. 
• Ms. Raymond asks about the plan for recruitment if positions remain unfilled, and Mr. Bowse explains 
the challenges with elementary positions. 
 
Personnel Recommendations and Certification Acronyms 
• Ms. Giglio questions the certification acronyms, and Mr. Bowse explains the changes in licensing 
pathways and clarifies the acronyms: EEL (Experienced Educator License), BEL (Beginning Educator 
License), INT (Intern Authorization License), and SOE (Statement of Eligibility). 
• Ms. Lewis asks a clarifying question about renominations vs. nominations.  Mr. Bowse offers to explain 
renominations after the meeting. 
 
Ms. Lewis moved, seconded by Ms. Giglio, to approve the Personnel Recommendations dated 7-20-26.  Motion 
passes 3-0. 
 
Head Teacher Job Description 
• Mr. Bowse explains the focus on the high school level and the need to update job descriptions, outlining 
length of service for head teachers and the evaluation process. 
• Ms. Raymond asks about the current practice and the involvement of the teachers' union in the evaluation 
process. 
• Dr. Andrade explains the need for feedback from the board of education on the evaluation process. 
• Ms. Lewis asks about the performance evaluation for head teachers and the possibility of teachers 
evaluating their head teachers.  Mr. Bowse explains that only Administrators can evaluate, but they may 
ask for feedback from teachers. 
• Mr. Bowse further explains the five main criteria for evaluating head teachers: effective instructional 
leadership, communication, timely completion of responsibilities, professionalism, and positive 
contribution to school culture. 
• Ms. Giglio and Ms. Raymond discuss the length of service for head teachers, with Ms. Giglio supporting 
evaluation and Mr. Bowse open to different term lengths. 
• Mr. Bowse will work on the head teacher evaluation and bring back the feedback to the next HR 
committee for further discussion. 
 
Ms. Giglio moved, seconded by Ms. Lewis, to adjourn at 6:01 pm.  Motion passes 3-0.   
 
 
Submitted by Tara C. Kinsella
